The best free CRM software for small businesses

Every big CRM has a free plan, and each one draws the line in a different place: users, contacts, pipelines or email. Here is what you get without paying, from each company's own pages, and who each one suits.

We make Slop CRM, one of the tools on this page. Every fact about the other tools comes from their own pages, linked under each one, as they read on 2026-10-24. Prices and features change: check each site before you choose.

How we compared them

  • What the free plan allows: users, contacts or records, pipelines
  • Day-to-day selling: deals, tasks, follow-ups, notes, email
  • Mobile apps and integrations
  • Account needed, and where your customer data is kept

1. HubSpot CRM

Best for: Small sales teams who want email tracking, meetings, forms and live chat for free

Good

  • Email tracking and notifications, email templates and scheduling on the free plan
  • Deal pipelines, tasks, meeting scheduling, live chat, sales quotes and reporting dashboards
  • Over 2,000 integrations in its marketplace

Not so good

  • Free plan stops at two users and 1,000 contacts
  • Multiple currencies and removing HubSpot branding start on Starter
  • A HubSpot account and its servers hold your data

HubSpot CRM website · Sources: HubSpot free CRM

2. Zoho CRM (Free edition)

Best for: Up to three people who want leads, deals and workflow automation at no cost

Good

  • Leads, deals, workflow automation and follow-up reminders free
  • Tasks, meetings and calls tracked; standard reports
  • API access (5,000 calls a day) and a mobile app

Not so good

  • Exporting data is limited to 10 times on the free edition
  • Sending email through Gmail or Outlook and mass emails are on Standard
  • Three users at most

Zoho CRM (Free edition) website · Sources: Zoho CRM pricing

3. Slop CRM (ours)

Best for: One person tracking customers and follow-ups with no limits, no account and nothing uploaded

Customers with several phones, emails and addresses, groups and tags, a pipeline board from lead to customer, dated notes and follow-up dates, linked to the orders and invoices of the Slop business apps.

Good

  • No limit on customers, notes or tags
  • Pipeline board you move by dragging, a follow-up list, dated notes
  • Each customer's orders and invoices from the Slop business apps
  • CSV export of selected customers; import from Slop Contacts without duplicates

Not so good

  • No email sending or tracking, no forms, no marketing tools
  • Four fixed stages (lead, contacted, customer, lost); one pipeline
  • One person in one browser: no team, no sync between devices
  • No phone app or integrations outside the Slop apps

Open Slop CRM

4. Bigin by Zoho CRM (Free)

Best for: A single person who wants a simple pipeline CRM with phone apps and a booking page

Good

  • One pipeline with stages you can change
  • Built-in phone, a booking page, web forms and a business card scanner free
  • Apps for iOS, iPadOS, Android and macOS

Not so good

  • Free plan: one user and 500 records (pipelines, contacts, activities and notes all count)
  • Three automations on the free plan
  • Email and WhatsApp integration start on Express

Bigin by Zoho CRM (Free) website · Sources: Bigin pricing

Which one to choose

For most small teams HubSpot's free CRM is the one to try first: email tracking, meetings, forms and live chat for two users, with a large set of integrations. Zoho CRM's free edition fits three users who want workflow automation, and Bigin is a simple pipeline CRM for one person with good phone apps, within 500 records.

Slop CRM is for someone who wants a private customer list and pipeline with no limits and no sign-up, tied to the free Slop invoicing apps. It does not send email or support a team.

Questions

What is the best free CRM?

For a small team, HubSpot's free CRM (two users, 1,000 contacts) has the most selling tools. Zoho CRM is free for three users, Bigin for one user and 500 records. Slop CRM has no limits but is for one person and has no email.

Which free CRM has no contact limit?

Of these, Slop CRM sets no limit. HubSpot's free plan allows 1,000 contacts and Bigin 500 records; Zoho CRM's pricing page does not state a contact limit for the free edition.

Can I use a CRM without an account?

Slop CRM runs in your browser with no account and keeps the data on your device. HubSpot, Zoho CRM and Bigin are online services you sign up for.

Which free CRM works on my phone?

HubSpot, Zoho CRM and Bigin have phone apps. Slop CRM works in the phone's browser, with the data kept in that browser.
